title: Order Uplift on Service-Fee Share Refunds (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
# Order uplift on service-fee share refunds (Cartwise Grocery Orders)

**Order uplift** — a percentage raise on the fee share of a Cartwise Grocery Orders service-fee share refund, keyed to the order's item subtotal and to whether a delivery fee is billed on the order.

**Definition.** When the order's item subtotal is at least 125.00 and a delivery fee is billed on it, the fee share is raised by 10 percent; when the item subtotal is below 125.00 and a delivery fee is billed, it is raised by 5 percent; when no delivery fee is billed, there is no uplift. The uplift multiplies the unrounded fee share, and the share is rounded to the cent once.

The item subtotal is the sum of the order's billed item lines. A delivery fee is billed when the order's fee entries carry a delivery fee charge above zero.

## Both sides of the threshold (hypothetical subtotals)

| Item subtotal | Delivery fee billed | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 125.00 | Yes | 10 percent |
| 124.99 | Yes | 5 percent |
| 180.00 | No | None |
| 40.00 | No | None |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A fee share of 1.2375 on an order with an item subtotal of 132.40 and a delivery fee charge of 3.99 is raised by 10 percent to 1.36125 before it is rounded to the cent. On an order whose item subtotal is 96.00 with a delivery fee charged, the same fee share is raised by 5 percent to 1.299375 before rounding.

A pickup order carries no delivery fee charge, so it takes no uplift.
